notes: Laptop tab rebuilt into a proper finder — screens AND batteries. Switch between Screens and Batteries, then type a laptop model OR a part number. It searches your chosen suppliers directly (AJ Parts, eBay UK, LaptopScreen, Screens.uk, NewModeUS, MobileSentrix, Maxbhi, Google) — all on by default, untick any you don't buy from (saved on the stick). A much bigger built-in database of common UK-repair laptops lists the interchangeable panels/batteries for each, with a '£ compare' button that opens them all so you grab the cheapest. Part numbers are now colour-coded — letters in blue, digits in amber — so B and 8, or O and 0, can't be mixed up, with a warning on the ones that are easy to misread. Revision gotchas throughout: HD vs FHD, 60 vs 144/165Hz, 30 vs 40-pin, touch panels needing a matching firmware/controller revision, swollen-battery safety and more. Every result has Copy, direct supplier search and Add-to-ticket.
